result.title: Backpropagating Verifier Rewards Through Continuous Flow Language Models
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models. Language models that generate continuous token embeddings are emerging as a strong alternative, but RL post-training for them remains understudied. We propose \method{}, a post-training framework for continuous flow language models. Such a model denoises token embeddings over multiple steps and decodes them into discrete tokens only at the last step. To obtain pathwise gradients, which backpropagate through continuous actions and have much lower variance than REINFORCE, we introduce a critic that estimates the value of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step. The critic must also keep track of the value function as the policy changes; to this end, we design a critic that predicts a value from every token representation and improves policy optimization. Across four reasoning tasks, \method{} reliably improves a continuous flow language model through RL post-training and outperforms baseline methods of the same type.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为「连续流」语言模型提出 RL 后训练框架：模型在多个步骤中逐步去噪出连续 token 嵌入，仅在最后一步解码为离散 token，并训练一个 critic 估计中间嵌入的价值，以绕过不可微的解码环节、用低方差的路径梯度把 verifier 奖励反传回连续动作，在四个推理任务上验证其优于同类基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文虽属纯文本而非视觉多模态，但其「对中间连续表征估值 + 逐步奖励反传」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督、中间步贡献分配与信用分配提供可核查的方法线索。
